verdict.rationale: Semgrep Supply Chain (SCA) evidence covers dependency vulnerability detection, reachability analysis, SBOM generation, and malicious dependency detection, but nothing in the evidence pack describes generating concrete upgrade paths or automated fix pull requests for vulnerable dependencies. The --autofix flag ([semgrep-docs-38],[semgrep-docs-53]) applies to Semgrep Code's rule-defined fixes for SAST findings, not dependency remediation.
